command: env PLATFORM=kvm ARCH=x86 BPFREJIT_CORPUS_APPS=katran BPFREJIT_BENCH_PASSES=map_inline SAMPLES=3 WORKLOAD_DURATION=60 KEEP_WORKDIRS=1 make corpus -o runtime-kernel-image
control_command: env PLATFORM=kvm ARCH=x86 BPFREJIT_CORPUS_APPS=katran SKIP_REJIT=norejit BPFREJIT_BENCH_PASSES=, SAMPLES=3 WORKLOAD_DURATION=60 KEEP_WORKDIRS=1 make corpus -o runtime-kernel-image

derived_counts.note: Every derived value is computed from the retained details/loadtime-reports/katran.jsonl stream and the retained per-step bytecode in details/loadtime-workdirs/. The paper's declared Katran 21/62 site figures are not merged with this fresh 16 figure.

log_normalization: Guest-console carriage returns and trailing horizontal whitespace normalized in the retained copy.
scope: Fresh local KVM single-pass map_inline run for Katran only, with two matched no-pass controls. It carries both the rewrite reconciliation (one changed load instance, balancer_ingress, 16 applied sites, before/after instruction counts) and the controlled per-pass throughput causality (raw and control-corrected median ratios). SAMPLES=3 at 60 s per sample per the framework's authoritative measurement policy. The paper's June Katran ratios are a separate generation and are never merged with these numbers.

throughput_causality.metric: median post/baseline summed kernel-pktgen pps over 3+3 samples
throughput_causality.note: The two no-pass controls are matched restarts of the same app at identical 60 s duration with enabled_passes=[], so their spread measures restart drift rather than pass effect. The fresh pktgen workload splits into four components per phase, so each phase's throughput is the sum over all components of its kernel-pktgen pps scalar.
